rationale: SUPERSEDES the affirm recorded earlier on 2026-07-28. The entity is KELLEHER FINANCIAL ADVISORS, LLC of New York, NY; the website its ADV declares (starboardadvisorsllc.com, redirecting to starboardadvisor.com) presents as Starboard Advisors and reads as Maine-based. The 'Family Office Services' navigation that the affirm rested on is on that site. Its roster names people with explicit firm suffixes - 'Bart Haag, Albin Randall and Bennett', 'Hugh O'Donnell, True Equity', 'Colleen Kelleher Sorrentino, Kelleher Financial Advisors', 'Arthur L. Goetchius, Chief Executive Officer, Kelleher Financial Advisors' - which reads as an advisory board listing member firms, not as one company's staff page. Either Kelleher trades as Starboard (the ADV does declare the domain) or Starboard is a separate firm on whose board Kelleher people sit. On the second reading the affirming evidence belongs to a different company, which is the wrong-entity defect this dataset already carries once (arrowrootadvisors.com). Held unresolved pending identity resolution rather than counted on ambiguous evidence.
